_notes.time_format: how StartTime is written; CTU-13 uses 2011/08/16 10:01:46.972101
_notes.window_seconds: length of one time window in seconds
_notes.monitored_prefix: only source IPs starting with this text are judged (the network being protected); empty = all
_notes.blocklist_file: file of known C&C server IPs, one per line; empty = no blocklist
_notes.plot_top_n: how many IPs to show in top_fanout.png
_notes.signals: each signal: threshold, points added when it fires, and its group
_notes.group_caps: maximum points a group can add, so one behaviour is not counted twice
_notes.severity: score needed for each level; medium and high are reported
_notes.ml: optional decision tree, used with --ml or enabled=true
